hints.label: nudge
hints.text: Memory grows in proportion to requests, not in proportion to traffic spikes. Something is being kept that nobody ever asks for again.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Run app/loadgen.py and watch RSS, then look at the worker's module-level containers. Compare how many entries the cache holds with how many distinct keys are ever asked for again.

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: The cache is keyed by the raw query string and has no size limit or expiry. Bound it (an LRU with a maximum size) and keep normalising the key so repeat queries still hit.
